scope: 12 papers and 1 technical article; selected primary-source review, not an exhaustive systematic review

reviewed.title: DAgger
reviewed.evidence_boundary: refresh motivation; no universal LLM guarantee

reviewed.title: GKD
reviewed.training_objective: full token FKL/RKL/JSD; stop sampling gradient
reviewed.evidence_boundary: separate rollout source, divergence and gradient

reviewed.title: MiniLLM
reviewed.training_objective: sequence RKL policy optimization with stabilization
reviewed.evidence_boundary: method is not fixed-prefix full-vocab semi-gradient

reviewed.title: On-Policy Distillation
reviewed.evidence_boundary: technical article, not a refresh-frequency controlled trial

reviewed.title: On Teacher Hacking
reviewed.evaluation: proxy teacher and gold oracle divergences
reviewed.evidence_boundary: teacher fidelity differs from task correctness

reviewed.title: Rethinking OPD
reviewed.evaluation: task scores; overlap, mass, entropy, prefix depth
reviewed.evidence_boundary: overlap is a diagnostic, not a success threshold

reviewed.title: Every Coin Has Two Sides
reviewed.sections: Sections 2–5; Figure 6; Appendix B; local TeX
reviewed.evaluation: in-domain and cross-domain tasks; top-16 overlap
reviewed.evidence_boundary: observed generalization is not full distribution equality

reviewed.title: Semi-OPD
reviewed.training_rollout: fixed initial student versus refreshed student
reviewed.evaluation: math avg@32, endpoint and normalized AUC, dynamics
reviewed.evidence_boundary: not evidence that full-vocab fixed-S0 risk always wins

reviewed.title: On-Policy or Off-Policy Learning?
reviewed.evidence_boundary: loss/source/LR controlled; sequence identities have assumptions

reviewed.title: Reverse-KL Policy Distillation
reviewed.evidence_boundary: boundedness and optimization assumptions; not an Adam theorem

reviewed.title: Transfer-Stratified OPD
reviewed.evaluation: task scores, transfer gap, problem strata
reviewed.evidence_boundary: multiple interventions; endpoint KL difference not RL absorption

reviewed.title: Scaling Properties
reviewed.evaluation: gold score versus square-root KL to initialization
reviewed.evidence_boundary: reference is S0, not teacher; one-run grid

reviewed.title: TOP-D
reviewed.evidence_boundary: minibatch partition is not reuse16 of identical trajectories
